headings: (500 ML) JASMINE & MUSK HAND AND BODY CREAM

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) JASMINE & MUSK HAND AND BODY CREAM
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented hand and body cream. Comes in a container with a dispenser.

Jasmine & Musk | A radiant veil of creamy, intimate amber slowly seduces the air, capturing the search for eternal comfort. Calm yet profound floral notes illuminate a velvety accord with an aura of elegance and warmth.

Notes:
Top: pear flower, peach.
Heart: ambroxan, tonka bean, jasmine, iris.
Base: musk, white cedar, patchouli.
